name: AR_AUTOMATCH_RULES
description: This table stores the header level information on the Automatch rules

columns.name: AUTOMATCH_RULE_ID
columns.description: Automatch Rule Identifier

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Automatch Rule Name

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description for the AutoMatch rule.

columns.name: SET_ID
columns.description: Identifies a set of reference data shared across business units and other entities. Also known as Reference Data Sets, they are used to filter reference data in transactional UIs.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start Date

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End Date

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Says whether the rule is active or not

columns.name: CUSTOMER_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Minimum matching reference score needed to automatically accept a customer recommendation on a receipt.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Minimum matching reference score value comprised of customer, transaction, and amount thresholds needed for a transaction recommendation to be automatically accepted on a receipt.

columns.name: MIN_MATCH_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Minimum matching reference score needed for a recommendation to be displayed to the user.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_DAYS_CLOSED
columns.description: Days past closure for transaction for considering for automatch

columns.name: TRANSACTION_REGEXP
columns.description: Regular expression to unpadded transaction string.

columns.name: REMITTANCE_REGEXP
columns.description: Regular expression to unpadded remittance string.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_WEIGHT
columns.description: Relative importance of a transaction match within the weighted thresholds of an AutoMatch rule set.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_WEIGHT
columns.description: Relative importance of a customer match within the weighted thresholds of an AutoMatch rule set.

columns.name: AMOUNT_WEIGHT
columns.description: Relative importance of an amount match within the weighted thresholds of an AutoMatch rule set.

columns.name: NET_TAX_WEIGHT
columns.description: Relative importance of a net of tax amount within the amount weight threshold of an AutoMatch rule set.

columns.name: NET_FREIGHT_WEIGHT
columns.description: Relative importance of a net of freight amount within the amount weight threshold of an AutoMatch rule set.

columns.name: NET_TAX_FREIGHT_WEIGHT
columns.description: Relative importance of a net of tax and freight amount within the amount weight threshold of an AutoMatch rule set.

columns.name: NET_UNDISC_WEIGHT
columns.description: Relative importance of unearned discounts within the amount weight threshold of an AutoMatch rule set.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
